Copied unchanged from the Ta'aleem Classroom (src/lib/), except url.mjs (a two-line stand-in):
the Qāf tracker that follows a recitation word by word, on the device (no audio leaves it).
The model itself (models/qaaf-asr.onnx, ~59 MB) is served by the Ta'aleem site, so recitation works when the game is
played on taaleem.ca. Elsewhere the game says so and offers tapping instead.
